image_description: A green iguana with white banding is perched on a light-colored log or rock structure. The iguana has a prominent dorsal crest, a large dewlap (partially obscured by pink flower petals it appears to be eating), and distinct white stripes across its body and tail. The background consists of dark gravel and a large grey rock.
